test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 100000 at 20% per annum for 3 years 3 months, compounded annually.
solution:
**Given:**

Principle (P) = Rs. 100000 

Rate of interest (R) = 20% per annum 

Time period (T) = 3 years 3 months = 3 + 1/4 = 3.25 years

**Formula Used:**

Interest = (P × R × T)/100

Interest = Amount - Principle

**Calculations:**

According to the question interest is compounded annually,

For first-year = P × R% × T₁

⇒ Interest (I₁) = 100000 × 0.2 × 1 = 20000

For the second year P₂ = P + P₁ = 100000 + 20000 = Rs. 120000

⇒ Interest (I₂) = 120000 × 0.2 × 1 = 24000

For the third year P₃ = P₂ + I₂ = 120000 + 24000 = 144000

⇒ Interest (I₃) = 144000 × 0.2 × 1 = 28800

For the last year P₄ = P3 + I3 = 144000 + 28800 = 172800

⇒ Interest (I3) = 172800 × 0.2 × 0.25 = 8640

New amount = 172800 + 8640 = 181440

Total Interest = 181440 - 100000 = Rs. 81440

**∴ The total compound interest will be Rs. 81440.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**3 years 3 months

⇒ 3 years + 3/12 years

⇒ 3 years + 1/4 years

So, the amount becomes after 3 years and 3 months

⇒ 100000(1 + 20/100)³ × (1 + {{{1 over 4} × 20} over 100}) - 100000

⇒ 172800 × (1 + 0.05) - 100000

⇒ 181440 - 100000

⇒ Rs. 81440

∴ The total compound interest will be Rs. 81440.

Amount at the end of 3 years 

⇒ 100000 (1 + 20/100)³

⇒ 172800

Amount at the end of 3 years and 3 months

⇒ 172800 + (172800 × 5%)

⇒ 181440

CI = 181440 - 100000

⇒ 81440
